description: This file defines an abstract class 'Schema' implementing database schema management functions for Drupal, including table and index operations, schema introspection, and SQL execution.

classes.name: Schema
classes.description: Abstract class providing base implementation for database schema operations in Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the schema object with a database connection and a unique identifier.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Implements cloning behavior, resetting the unique identifier.

methods.name: uniqueIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this schema object.

methods.name: nextPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns the next placeholder index for query parameterization.

methods.name: getPrefixInfo
methods.description: Retrieves schema, prefix, and table name info based on the table name and connection prefix.

methods.name: prefixNonTable
methods.description: Creates a name for indexes, primary keys, and constraints, avoiding {} notation.

methods.name: executeDdlStatement
methods.description: Executes a DDL SQL statement, handling transaction support.

methods.name: buildTableNameCondition
methods.description: Builds a condition object for matching table names in information_schema.

methods.name: tableExists
methods.description: Checks if a table exists in the database.

methods.name: findTables
methods.description: Finds all tables matching a pattern, considering prefixes.

methods.name: fieldExists
methods.description: Checks if a column exists in a specified table.

methods.name: getFieldTypeMap
methods.description: Abstract method to get mapping of Drupal field types to database-native types.

methods.name: renameTable
methods.description: Abstract method to rename a table.

methods.name: dropTable
methods.description: Abstract method to drop a table.

methods.name: addField
methods.description: Abstract method to add a new field to a table.

methods.name: dropField
methods.description: Abstract method to drop a field from a table.

methods.name: indexExists
methods.description: Abstract method to check if an index exists.

methods.name: addPrimaryKey
methods.description: Abstract method to add a primary key to a table.

methods.name: dropPrimaryKey
methods.description: Abstract method to drop a primary key.

methods.name: findPrimaryKeyColumns
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns; throws if not implemented.

methods.name: addUniqueKey
methods.description: Abstract method to add a unique key.

methods.name: dropUniqueKey
methods.description: Abstract method to drop a unique key.

methods.name: addIndex
methods.description: Abstract method to add an index.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Abstract method to drop an index.

methods.name: introspectIndexSchema
methods.description: Retrieves index schema info; throws if not implemented.

methods.name: changeField
methods.description: Abstract method to change a field's definition.

methods.name: createTable
methods.description: Creates a new table from schema definition, throws if exists.

methods.name: createTableSql
methods.description: Abstract method to generate SQL for creating a table.

methods.name: fieldNames
methods.description: Extracts field names from key/index specifications.

methods.name: prepareComment
methods.description: Prepares a comment string for database query.

methods.name: escapeDefaultValue
methods.description: Escapes a default value for a column.

methods.name: ensureNotNullPrimaryKey
methods.description: Ensures primary key fields are defined as NOT NULL.
